title: Technical Account Management Director (APAC)
description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers-no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With 30 offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at  verve.com .

Who You Are

We are looking for a Technical Account Management Director - APAC to lead and scale our TAM organization across China, India, Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia. You will own publisher revenue growth and operational excellence across our Performance and Branding platforms, build a high-performing regional team, and act as the senior voice of our APAC publisher community inside Verve.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on SSP / AdTech leader who combines deep monetization expertise, data-driven thinking and people leadership, with a proven ability to deliver both technical execution and commercial outcomes.

What You Will Do

• Team Leadership & Strategy

• Lead, coach and develop the APAC TAM team across China, India, Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia, strengthening both technical and commercial capabilities

• Define team structure, priorities and performance metrics aligned with revenue goals

• Revenue & Performance Ownership

• Own and drive publisher revenue growth across the Verve Performance P+ Platform (formerly PubNative) and the Verve Branding P+ Platform (formerly Smaato)

• Monitor revenue and other key metrics , proactively identifying risks and growth opportunities

• Lead performance optimization initiatives across traffic, demand channels and ad formats

• Publisher & Partner Management

• Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier publishers and strategic partners

• Serve as the senior escalation point for key accounts

• Partner closely with Commercial teams to support onboarding, expansion and retention

• Technical & Operational Excellence

• Oversee the end-to-end publisher lifecycle, including:

• Integration kickoff and onboarding

• SDK / mediation integrations (e.g., MAX, LevelPlay, Google Admob)

• New inventory enablement

• SDK version updates

• Uphold high standards in:

• Discrepancy monitoring and resolution

• P2P revenue validation

• Traffic quality and compliance

• Data & Insights

• Work closely with the Analytics team to develop optimization strategies

• Use data analysis to identify performance issues and optimization opportunities

• Translate data into actionable insights for both internal teams and external partners

• Drive adoption of best practices across monetization strategies

• Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Product, Engineering and Demand teams to resolve technical issues and improve product performance

• Provide structured market feedback to influence the product roadmap

• Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve efficiency and scalability

What We Are Looking For

Must Have

• 8+ years of experience in SSP / AdTech account management or technical account management

• Strong understanding of the programmatic ecosystem , including mediation (MAX, LevelPlay), header bidding and SDK integrations

• Proven track record of managing publisher relationships and driving revenue growth

• Experience leading and scaling regional or global teams

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working across multiple markets and time zone

Nice to Have

• Experience working across APAC markets

• Familiarity with both branding and performance monetization models

• Background in mobile

title: Staff Safety-Critical Software Engineer (R5788)
description:

With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking an engineer to help design, develop, and integrate a safety critical Run-Time Assurance (RTA) product. title: Commercial Counsel
description:
ABOUT US

Temporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster. We are on a mission to be the reliable foundation of every developer’s toolbox, and are building the team that will make that happen.

Our values guide us -they are present in how we show up, make decisions, and work together to make an impact. We’re curious, driven, collaborative, genuine and humble.

Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Commercial Counsel on Temporal’s Legal team, you'll work on a diverse mix of customer, procurement, and other commercial contracts while serving as a trusted legal partner to cross-functional teams. You'll build and maintain direct relationships with key stakeholders and have the opportunity to help build a scalable legal function, directly impacting the company.

Reporting to the Director of Commercial Legal, you’ll help build and maintain our commercial legal infrastructure, including contract templates, playbooks, and processes to support Temporal's current and next stage of growth.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Support our commercial contracting efforts for both the sell-side and buy-side by drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of agreements such as MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, and vendor agreements.

- Partner closely with Sales and our GTM teams as a trusted advisor, providing clear, solution-oriented legal guidance that helps accelerate business objectives.

- Support partner and reseller-related agreements, including reseller or channel relationships, marketplace arrangements, and strategic collaborations.

- Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of contract templates, negotiation guidelines, and scalable contracting processes.

- Identify and escalate legal risks appropriately while supporting business momentum.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- J.D. from an accredited law school and active license to practice law in the U.S.

- 5+ years of legal experience, with a minimum of 4 years in-house experience at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

- Strong track record drafting and negotiating vendor, procurement, and technology agreements, with a solid understanding of common commercial deal structures, including SaaS subscriptions, professional services, data processing terms, and SLA frameworks.

- Experience with contracts management systems (Ironclad preferred) and AI-powered contract tools.

- Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a drive to solve emerging challenges in an evolving environment.

- Passion for tackling complex challenges on a small Legal team and willingness to wear multiple hats.

- Privacy experience is a plus.

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Perception team builds the system which learns the spatial-temporal representation and their semantic meanings of the surrounding environment of the self-driving car, i.e., the system that “perceives” the world around the car. The core challenge within Model Lifecycle is accelerating Waymo's ML development cycle. As we scale to new cities and vehicle platforms, our data volume is exploding, and our models are becoming more complex, handling more and more tasks. This team is critical to controlling that complexity.

Waymo interns work with leaders in the industry on projects that deliver significant impact to the company. • Develop metrics and analyses that explain where models fail and which data would fix those failures.

• Strong programming skills in Python.

• Ability to design controlled experiments and draw sound conclusions from quantitative results.

title: Senior People Ops Manager - Payroll & Systems
description:
About Convergent Research
Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO). We architect critical infrastructure that removes bottlenecks to breakthrough scientific research.
FROs are mission-driven, time-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks. Convergent secures funding and provides the operational backbone that allows scientists and engineers to move quickly, from legal formation and governance to hiring, finance, communications, and operational systems. We’ve taken 14 FROs from idea to operating entity, including four launches in 2026.
 
About the Role
Payroll probably isn’t the first thing that comes to mind when you think about breakthrough science. But scientists can’t do their best work if they aren’t paid correctly, benefits aren’t working, or their organization isn’t set up to employ them.
That’s where you come in.
We’re looking for a Senior People Ops Manager - Payroll & Systems to own the people ops infrastructure that keeps Convergent and our FROs running smoothly. You’ll make sure our employees get paid accurately and on time, our policies and systems keep pace with our growth, new FROs become functioning employers, and organizations completing their missions can wind down responsibly.
This is a senior, hands-on expert role. We’re looking for someone who knows parts of this work better than we do. Someone who doesn’t just identify problems but brings recommendations, builds solutions, and sets the standard for how we operate. You’ll have significant autonomy to make decisions within your domain, with the Head of People providing final approval on decisions that impact company-wide strategy or multiple teams.
You’ll report to our Head of People and work closely with our People Ops Manager - Employee Experience, who owns recruiting, onboarding, and internal communications, and our Sr. HRBP, who serves as the primary point of contact for FRO employees. You’ll also partner with our Launch team, which coordinates the many moving pieces involved in getting a new FRO off the ground or winding one down. As we grow, there may be an opportunity to add a coordinator to support routine administrative work.
A quick note on payroll: We use TriNet as our US PEO and Rippling for UK payroll. Our providers handle tax calculations and filings, but that doesn’t mean we’ve outsourced accountability. You’ll own the accuracy of the inputs, review the outputs, and make sure issues get resolved. A second member of People Ops will provide an independent pre-run review.
This role will initially be approximately 60% hands-on execution and 40% policy development, infrastructure building, and continuous improvement. We need someone who enjoys both.

We believe in hiring individuals based on their unique talents, not on race, color, religion, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law or our company policies. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Anthropic’s Inference organization serves Claude to millions of users and enterprise customers, across our own products and the world’s largest cloud platforms, with the speed, reliability, and efficiency that frontier AI demands. The stack that makes this possible is deep and tightly coupled: accelerator kernels, an in-house inference engine that manages the entire token path for both production and research workloads, distributed routing, autoscaling, and capacity management. Every layer affects the others, often in ways that are hard to see in isolation. We build across GPUs, TPUs, and Trainium, and the complexity of building, testing, and shipping inference software grows with every platform we add.

•
Scaling and infrastructure. Routing, autoscaling, and capacity management for the serving fleet, and bringing new capacity online.

Velocity. The toolchains, development environments, and CI/CD that let inference engineers build, test, and ship across every accelerator platform.

•
Inference engine. The software between the accelerator kernels and the routing layer that serves every request.

•
Performance. Improving throughput, latency, cost, and reliability across the stack, with correctness treated as part of performance.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Sr. Product Operations Manager I, VR International

Our Mission is to Protect Life

We are out to make the world a safer place by solving big problems and tackling the toughest challenges in public safety. From Axon's inception building the TASER device to today's ecosystem of connected hardware and software, our focus is helping officers and agencies serve their communities with confidence, safety, and integrity. Agencies around the world are asking for it, and Axon is now scaling its VR training platform into new international markets, with launches underway or planned across Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific.

As we grow and scale, we are discovering what it takes to deploy VR training in each new market, and how needs differ by culture, region, and language. What made us successful in the US and Canada does not translate one-for-one, and every region, including EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, has its own needs.

title: Product Design Lead (Canada)
description:
This is a fully remote role based in Canada. Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada.

About Proof

We’re Proof , a high-growth company in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We’ve built a best-in-class platform trusted by thousands of law firms across the United States for Service of Process, the formal delivery of legal documents, and E-Filing. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing, delivering over a million documents per year through a network of thousands of process servers. We’re working to make the legal system more efficient, transparent, and accessible than it’s traditionally been.

Design at Proof

We design for the whole service, not just the interface. We aren't a downstream team turning tickets into screens; we help the company understand complex problems, make ambiguity concrete, and decide what should become simpler before more gets built.

Design isn't an approval gate that every decision has to pass through. Depending on the work, we may lead the problem framing, partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to explore a solution, or help a team improve work already underway. The goal is to bring the right level of design involvement while important decisions are still open.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to take on challenging product and service workflows, with a primary focus on the onboarding workflows that power legal document delivery.

Delivering documents in the real world comes with inevitable edge cases and complications. An action in the field ripples through our internal systems and what a law firm sees. For example, if a process server finds a recipient has moved, the law firm needs clarity, internal teams need to resolve the exception, and the delivery workflow changes. Designing here means understanding those connections and deciding whether the right intervention is software, a process shift, automation, or all three.

You’ll report directly to the Director of Design on a small, high-leverage team, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to frame ambiguous problems, explore tradeoffs, and shape direction before solutions are locked in.

You’ll have meaningful autonomy to frame problems, choose the right approach, and drive work forward, with close cross-functional partnership, not a prescribed playbook.

What you’ll do

• Own complex workflows end-to-end: Aid in framing problems, navigate ripple effects across operations, servers, and customers, and drive through to delivery.

• Prototype to learn: Build prototypes at the right fidelity to test assumptions, make ideas tangible, and help teams make clear decisions early.

• Work with the hood open: Share unfinished work early, invite critique, and partner with Product, Engineering, and operations while problems are still malleable.

• Design whole systems, not just screens: Create coherent workflows, interfaces, information architecture, and states across digital tools and operational processes.

• Contribute to the practice: Create and improve interaction patterns and language within your work that help Operations specialists, process servers, and law firms move through the product without having to re-learn it. Share what you learn and work alongside other designers to strengthen craft and service thinking.

How we work

Part of the work here is strengthening how we build context, shifting toward an everyday habit, not a scheduled research phase. Rather than wait for complete briefs, we dig into the mechanics of the service by shadowing Operations specialists, listening to law-firm calls, talking with process servers, and asking questions until we have a solid understanding. From there, we move fluidly between sketching, prototyping, and writing clear recommendations to help teams make confident decisions while the problem is still open.

About Us

We are Ocado Group and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role

Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval is the product area behind the automated systems at the heart of Ocado's automated warehouses: the grid, the peripherals and the bots that run on it. Our mission is to develop the world's leading ASRS: highly cost-competitive, reliable, easy to launch and support and suitable for diverse global use cases.

As the Senior Product Manager for Retrieval, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for our bot, battery and charger fleet. Retrieval is the core driver of grid movement - bots transport stock and customer orders between grid locations, stations and ports, meaning every customer order depends on their availability, reliability and cost-effectiveness.

Operating at the intersection of hardware, firmware, wireless and cloud software, you will lead a critical product domain where even a small change to a bot scales across every operational site globally. You will collaborate closely with mechanical, mechatronics, firmware, wireless and cloud engineering teams, as well as manufacturing and field support teams, driving complex problem-solving and cross-domain alignment.

Key Responsibilities

• Product Vision & Strategy: Shape and execute the product vision for complex initiatives across the bot, battery and charger domain, balancing short- and long-term goals to lower Capex, Opex and lead time.

• Commercial & Data Leadership: Define key domain metrics connected directly to business outcomes. Manage financial rationale, balance KPI impacts and make informed Build vs. Buy decisions.

• Execution & Problem Solving: Lead discovery and problem-solving across cross-functional teams, setting high standards for scoping, requirements and data-driven hypothesis testing.

• Product Adoption & Scale: Build adoption metrics into domain capabilities, monitor usage across customer segments and collaborate with Solutions, Partner Growth and Partner Success teams to drive global rollout.

• Stakeholder Management & Evangelism: Manage relationships across engineering crafts, leadership levels and external partners. Articulate complex technical decisions clearly and build strong buy-in.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Synthetic Data
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

Simulation is advancing end-to-end autonomous driving research. The team’s mission is to accelerate AV2.0 by incubating capabilities that become company-level advantages - generative world models and the synthetic data they produce are one of those. The goal of this role is to build, scale, and optimise next-generation world model architectures (GAIA and successors) and bridge them into high-throughput generation and training infrastructure, so synthetic data can dramatically accelerate autonomy development. You will post-train world models for new embodiments and behaviours (rig transfer, pose transfer, dashcam restaging), generate multimodal synthetic experience at scale, and land that data in the same training stack we use for real driving. You sit between ML research and engineering: collaborating with scientists on architecture and conditioning, and with platform engineers on generation jobs, training artefacts, and how synthetic data is mixed into training. Your work will decide how fast we can train, evaluate, and deploy driving models on vehicles we have barely collected from.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Model development: Post-train, distill, and evaluate GAIA-family large video diffusion models to improve generation quality, controllability, and generalisation. Run ablation studies and investigate failures in visual quality, temporal consistency, motion, and action conditioning.

- Generation at scale: Build and run synthetic video generation pipelines across tens of thousands of driving segments. Optimise inference efficiency, manage GPU resources, and ensure data quality throughout the pipeline.

- From generation to training: Integrate synthetic data across different stages of driving-model training, develop sampling strategies, and measure its impact through evaluation suites and on-road performance.

- Cross-team collaboration: Work with driving-model teams to determine effective data mixtures and with simulation and evaluation teams to turn generated scenarios into useful closed-loop tests.

- Applied research: Translate advances in world modelling, video generation, flow matching, distillation, and data-centric training into measurable improvements in the models and data we deploy.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Post-train and iterate GAIA-class world models for synthetic-data capabilities: embodiment transfer (new camera/vehicle embodiments), pose transfer (rewritten ego trajectories), and related conditioning (geometry, calibration, actions).

- Own the generation loop: config → large-scale GPU inference → training-ready artefacts, with clear lineage from the model and settings that produced them.

- Land synthetic data in driving-model training (behaviour cloning, reward models, RL): binarisation, mix ratios, quality filters, and experiments that measure suite and on-road impact - including when synthetic should replace scarce real rig data.Diagnose and fix geometry, artefacts, calibration, and controllability failures that determine whether generated video is training-grade.

- Improve throughput and yield: inference optimisations (distillation, KV cache), valid-generation rate, and self-serve workflows so model developers can request synthetic sets without a specialist.

- Expand coverage to new vehicle platforms and safety-critical scenarios (OEM bring-up; Emergency Lane Keeping / Automatic Emergency Braking).

- Partner with world-model researchers, infra, and driving-model owners so generation, evaluation, and training stay one system.

- 4+ years in applied ML / research engineering, with a track record of training and s

title: Senior Consulting Engineer - EMEA
description:
ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 4,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.

As a Consulting Engineer, you're the hands-on engineer on our customers' most important projects. When a customer needs to migrate, integrate, or prove ClickHouse on a real workload, you work in the build alongside their engineers: you design it, build it, test it and hand it over.

You'll work on a broad mix of projects for customers across EMEA, from moving large workloads off other databases to building new real-time analytics on ClickHouse. Each one is scoped with clear goals from the start, so you know what success looks like and can get stuck in. It's a fast way to build deep experience across lots of different data problems.

The consulting function at ClickHouse is less than a year old, so you'll help shape how ClickHouse delivers this work as the team grows. Between projects you take cases alongside support engineers, which keeps you close to day-to-day support.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn customer goals into a scoped project with measurable success criteria, sizing and a timeline

- Design a target architecture and prove it against the customer's own data: schema and engine design, capacity and sizing, proofs of concept

- Do the build: implementation, pipelines and integrations, migration execution, tooling and automation

- Measure it before it matters, with benchmarking, load and functional testing, then support the cutover

- Tune what production reveals, then hand over with an engagement report and knowledge transfer, so the customer's team can run it without you

- Take L1 to L3 cases alongside support engineers when you're between projects

- Feed what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering, and turn your work into reference architectures, knowledge base articles and blog posts

- Work in a constant feedback loop with the Pre-sales team to ensure that the demos and POCs they present are credible when you put them into production

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years delivering hands-on technical work for customers, whether your title was consultant, professional services, solutions architect, senior support, SRE or something else

- Real depth in databases, whether analytical, transactional or relational

- Hands-on SQL. You regularly write complex queries from scratch, and tune and debug them yourself

- You've owned implementations, migrations or POCs for external customers from start to finish

- Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP and/or Azure)

- You've deployed and run workloads on Kubernetes yourself

- You give precise technical answers and explain them clearly

- Fluent English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with ClickHouse

- Hands-on Splunk experience

- Migrating analytical workloads from systems such as PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery or Elastic

- Terraform

- Data pipelines and streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark or Debezium

- Python, Bash or Go

- Involvement in open source, as a user, contributor or community member

GOOD TO KNOW

- This role is remote within EMEA, in a country where ClickHouse already hires

- Travel to customer sites is part of the job, up to 35% of your time, depending on the project: some need none, others weekly visits

- You'll join our EMEA Support Services team, where Support Engineers, Consulting Engineers and TAM Architects work as one team

- You'll be part of the on-call rotation, about one week a quarter, with time off in lieu if you're paged at a weekend

HOW WE HIRE

- A 30-minute call with our recruiter

- A conversation with the hiring manager

- A take-home exercise, designed to take three to four hours, with three working days to complete it

- A 90-minute technical interview with the team: you'll walk us through your take-home, then join a working session where you write and tune SQL live

- A final conversation with our VP of Support Services

- References, then an offer

title: Senior Data Analyst - Product
description:
Senior Data Analyst - Product

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one.

The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- Own the Domain’s Data - Define, maintain, and evolve the KPI framework for the domain across all pods (activation, adoption, usage, retention, monetisation, risk and cost signals), ensuring the team always has a reliable, shared view of how our products perform.

- Turn Behaviour into Insight - Run deep dives on user behaviour across funnels and product journeys to identify drop-offs, usage patterns, and unmet needs, then translate them into clear, prioritised recommendations for Product.

- Drive Experimentation - Partner with PMs and Designers to shape the experimentation roadmap by defining hypotheses, success and guardrail metrics, sample sizes, and test design, then run the readouts and make sure learnings feed back into the roadmap.

- Support Product Decisions End to End - Size opportunities, build business cases, and measure post-launch impact on new features and releases, closing the loop between what we ship and the outcomes it delivers.

- Build Monitoring & Self-Service Tools - Develop dashboards and reports (Hex, Looker, or similar) that give Product, Operations, and leadership real-time visibility on launches, performance, and anomalies, without needing to ask for a query.

- Partner with Key Stakeholders - Work daily with Product, Design, Engineering, and Operations to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations, up to the executive level.

- Enhance Analytics Through AI-Powered Workflows - Design and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate recurring analyses, anomaly detection, and reporting, and to speed up ad-hoc exploration.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone who is a product-minded analyst with a strong analytical mindset, who thrives in a collaborative, fast-moving environment, is detail-oriented, and is ready to take full ownership of a domain’s data.

- Relevant Experience - 4+ years in product analytics, data analytics, or BI roles, ideally embedded in a product team within a consumer app, fintech, or payments environment, with hands-on experience in high-volume, high-frequency event data.

- Product Analytics Expertise - Solid command of funnel, cohort, retention, and segmentation analysis, and of consumer lifecycle metrics (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Monetisation). Experience with Fintech-specific KPIs and sector dynamics is a strong plus.

- Experimentation - Proven experience designing and analysing A/B tests: hypothesis definition, power and sample size, guardrail metrics, statistical significance, and clear readouts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Technical Proficiency - Strong command of SQL and Python for analysis. Experience with dbt, Git, and notebook-based analytics (e.g. Hex, Databricks, Jupyter) is a plus.

- Data Visualisation - Experience with Hex, Looker, or similar tools to build clear, self-service dashboards and monitoring.

- AI Fluency - Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day for analytics, automation, ad-hoc analyses, and executive summaries. Basic to mid-level proficiency with Claude and experience interacting with agents programmatically via APIs is a strong plus.

- Analytical & Problem-Solvin

title: Co-Founder & CEO — AI Automation for Growing Companies
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadLoomwork, an AI automation venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Loomworkis an AI automation agency for growing companies. Every growing company knows AI is its next growth lever, but few have the people to turn it into working systems. Implementation is the scarce resource.Loomworkhelps them find where AI will pay off, builds agents into the tools they already use, and keeps those agents running. It launches as a services business with a dedicated technical delivery team from day one. Every engagement also serves as research: as client work converges on one segment, Loomwork turns its library of deployed agents into a connected product and grows from agency to software company.
Market Context
The global AI consulting services market is valued at $11.9B in 2026 and is projected to reach $73.9B by 2034, growing at a 25.6% CAGR. North America holds about 38% of the market. Enterprise AI adoption climbed from 20% in 2017 to 88% in 2025, and adoption is outpacing the talent available to deploy it. Roughly 190,000 US and Canadian companies fall in the $10M to $300M revenue range, which puts the serviceable market at an estimated $3B a year. Most of these companies are too large for freelancers and too small for enterprise firms.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

• Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across the industry and early-stage capital markets

• A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight ’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the direction of the venture and lead its execution.

• Strategy: Shape the service offering, pricing, and positioning, and choose the segment to specialize in based on where demand converges

• Customer Development: Win engagements with growing companies, move clients from assessment to build to retainer, and build the go-to-market motion

• Product: Partner with the FutureSight delivery and engineering team to turn repeated client builds into reusable agents and, ultimately, a connected product

• Capital: Lead future fundraising, supported by FutureSight 's network and the agency's traction

• Team: Recruit and lead the founding team, including a technical leader as the product takes shape, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

• Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

• Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

• Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

• Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

• Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

• Direct exposure to AI implementation, consulting, or selling technology services into growing companies

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn pro

title: RVP, Enterprise Sales
description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler-for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the Role
As the RVP of Enterprise Sales, you will play a critical leadership role in driving Contentsquare's growth across North America. You will lead, develop, and scale a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, establishing the regional sales strategy and driving new customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and revenue growth across strategic enterprise accounts.
This is an opportunity for an experienced sales leader who combines a strong track record of enterprise SaaS sales success with a passion for building and developing exceptional teams. You'll bring a hands-on, entrepreneurial approach to leadership, balancing strategic direction with active involvement in deal strategy, pipeline development, and coaching to help your team consistently deliver results.
Reporting to the VP of Sales, you will be a key member of Contentsquare's US Sales Leadership team, partnering closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Solutions Consulting, and Customer Success to accelerate regional growth, strengthen our market presence, and deliver long-term customer value.
What You'll Do
Lead regional sales performance: Own the Enterprise team's revenue performance, driving the achievement of individual, team, and regional targets while establishing a culture of accountability, high performance, and continuous improvement.

title: Software Support Consultant
description:
Tango’s system implementation and support follows the process of requirements, design, configure/ build, test and remediate, deploy, and support. The Services and Support teams in the Bangalore office work directly with Tango’s US based teams and with clients across the globe. The role requires candidates to work across the following areas:

• System design and configuration

• Report design/ development

• Testing

• Data conversion

• Integration design

• Support

Requirements:

• Ability to communicate effectively with international team members and clients

• Ability to effectively and quickly understand business processes and understand how technology enables those processes

• Good understanding of SDLC or software implementation lifecycle (applications like SAP, Oracle, or other ERP or web applications)

• Prior system configuration experience based on design specifications is a plus. The role will focus on configuration of a proprietary application based on Oracle’s ADF (Application Development Framework). No prior Oracle or ADF experience necessary.

• Investigates and reproduces issues, provides fixes and workarounds and verifies changes and ensure continued support of the software solution

• Ability to investigate challenging tickets from Client and close the tickets

• Monitor and own all support related metrics including ticket backlog, average time to close, workload distribution, first response time, resolution time and ticket escalations

• Strong understanding of databases like Oracle, SQL Server etc.

• Strong Excel skills

• Strong SQL skills

• Apply appropriate development methodologies (e.g.: agile, waterfall) and best practices (e.g.: mid-development client reviews, embedded QA procedures, unit testing) to ensure successful and timely completion

• Collaborate with other team members (involved in the requirements gathering, testing, roll-out and operations phases) to ensure seamless transitions. Summarize and present results to team members and clients globally

• Understand technical requirements to ensure accurate understanding and implementation

• Experience or familiarity with Business Intelligence and Data Visualization tools (Power BI / Tableau / Qlik) is good to have. Ability to work with data and derive meaningful insights through reports or dashboards will be an added advantage.

• This role has the potential to grow into gaining extensive knowledge within multiple client areas with the ability to provide consulting and expertise on business processes

• Ability to work within a virtual global team environment and contribute to the overall timely delivery of multiple projects

• Willingness to travel internationally as needed to work with client

• Willingness to work from 3 PM IST to 12 AM IST with appropriate breaks for meals

• Bachelor's/Master's degree with specialization in Computer Science, MIS, IT or other computer related disciplines

• 3-6 years of relevant consulting-industry experience working on medium-large scale technology solution delivery engagements

• Experience with working on Jira, Zendesk and similar tools.

• Extensive experience working with system implementation, reporting, back-end database management (e.g.: Oracle, Teradata) and/or ETL interfacing (e.g.: Informatica, SSIS) technologies

• Hands-on experience in Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik

• Need for immediate joining.

• Work from home.

Founded in 2018 in Bangalore, the center of India's high-tech industry area, Attain has grown to serve a global client base of startups, early stage companies, and SMEs.
Attain is US based software company TANGO's India partner. TANGO's software solution helps customers find, build and manage retail and office locations in a single suite/ software platform. Attain supports Tango with services in the areas of development, implementation, QA, and client support.

title: Software Engineer - Cybersecurity/SDN
description:
Does the opportunity to control the Internet traffic excite you?
Do you relish the opportunity to make a real impact?
Join our Cloud Technology team!
Our Cloud Technology team takes ownership for creating tools critical for planning, building, maintaining, and operating our global platform. We design, develop, and deploy critical software that enables the Akamai platform for infinite scalability.We are looking for a highly motivated software engineer. You will join our unique team of developers of the Akamai own distributed software-defined networking solution.
Partner with the best
This role involves learning cloud infrastructure and Akamai networking, designing software projects, and scaling distributed SDN solutions. Responsibilities include implementing inbound and outbound DDoS protection, managing lifecycle upgrades, expanding flow telemetry, and developing API-driven control systems. You will create automated configurations to safeguard extensive IP traffic flows across backbone connectivity layers and datacenter fabric.
As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for:

• Building tools and developing new features for existing software.

• Developing tests, test automation, and testing frameworks, performance benchmarks.

• Designing reliable, high-quality, usable software that meets the needs of Cloud Technology for indefinite scalability of deployed network,

• Creating reusable code and libraries.

• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure effective communication and code development.

• Creating developer documentation for the tools that you write when applicable.

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Demonstrate fluency in writing code in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, Go, Python, C++).

• Demonstrate knowledge and experience in maintaining software running on Linux.

• Understand networking concepts like IP addressing & IP routing, commonly-used protocols and types of networking equipment.

• Demonstrate basic understanding of DDoS mitigation methods and network flow telemetry.

• Demonstrate experience building API-driven control systems for automated network configuration and attack containment.

About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
FlexBase adapts to your job's needs
Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!
